password.title: Password
password.text: Use a password you don't use anywhere else.
password.rule: At least 8 characters, at most 72 bytes.
password.effect: Changing the password signs out your other sessions and revokes access for authorized apps.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.text: Ask for a one-time code after your password, passkey or linked-account sign-in.
mfa.totpText: Codes from an app such as Google Authenticator, 1Password or Microsoft Authenticator.
mfa.emailText: A code is sent to your verified email address at each sign-in.
mfa.disableConfirm: Sign-ins will no longer ask for a one-time code.
mfa.totpStep1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.totpStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for adding CP OAuth to an authenticator app
mfa.emailStep: We sent a 6-digit code to your verified email address. Enter it to turn on email codes.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.text: Sign in with your device's screen lock or a security key instead of a password.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: Helps you recognize the device later. Optional.
passkeys.removeConfirm: {name} will no longer be able to sign in to this account.
